snippet.title: Fishing & Life MV2
snippet.description:
Do you like to travel?
Ride a small boat on a quiet seaside,
Caress the waters with your fishing rod,
And connect with the ocean with your fishing line.
Catch a fish without a care in the world,
Then release it with a careful hand.
Fishing & Life is a simple game for simple times,
Where you can escape from the weariness of life.
Add healing to your weary days, if only for a while.
